rationale: FX01 is a row-level foreign-currency principal conversion check. The raw SOI shows a first lien secured debt position for Radar Bidco S.a.r.l. with non-USD par/shares (EUR 85,000) while cost and fair value are reported in USD. The reviewed artifact rows flag blank principal_amount_usd for non-USD source par, so the missing USD principal conversion is a real extraction/normalization defect rather than a false alarm.
